description:
The Defense Health Agency Contracting Activity (DHACA), Healthcare Contracting Division – West (HCD-W), intends to award a firm fixed price supply and preventive maintenance purchase for one (1) 75KW Electric Carbon Steel Steam Generator - 208V to support the operations of U.S. Naval Hospital Okinawa, Japan, Branch Dental Clinic, in accordance with the Federal Acquisition Regulation Revolutionary (FAR) Overhaul 13.101(b):

STERIS Corporation, 5960, Heisley Road, Mentor, Ohio, UEI: UGGQJGGH6846, Cage: 0NWN1

The objective of this sole source award is to procure equipment and installation, and deinstallation of existing equipment for Naval Hospital Okinawa (NHO), Japan. STERIS CORPORATION is the sole manufacturer of the 75KW Electric Carbon Steel Steam Generator - 208V and is proprietary with no authorized provider of this equipment. There is no reasonable expectation of receiving quotes from two or more small businesses. The proposed acquisition strategy is to justify as an Other Than Full and Open procurement on a sole source basis.

Delivery Date: June 1, 2026

Delivery Location: DLA TROOP SUPPORT XDOCK PROJECT, 4551 EAST PHILADELPHIA STREET, ONTARIO, CA 91761

If a vendor challenges the basis of this requirement, please email capability statements as a Microsoft Word or Adobe PDF attachment to Bobbie Dobberstein at bobbie.s.dobberstein.ctr@health.mil.
